system_name: UNILIS SmartLab - Laboratory Management & Practical Execution System
description: A comprehensive laboratory management and practical execution module built as a sub-module of the UNILIS LMS. SmartLab manages the complete lifecycle of laboratory practicals — from experiment creation and scheduling to student attendance verification, practical execution, notebook management, report submission, grading, and PDF datasheet generation with anti-tamper blockchain-based audit trails.

authentication_and_attendance.description: Multi-modal authentication and attendance verification system for lab sessions

methods.description: Standard registration number/email + password login. Supports role-based redirects.

Dynamic QR code login system. Generates time-limited QR sessions (5 min expiry). Phone scans QR, selects user identity, auto-login on subsequent scans via device fingerprint cookie. Also used for attendance marking per practical.
methods.workflow: Login page generates QR → student scans with phone → selects name → claims session → PC logs in automatically

methods.description: RFID card-based login. Cards can be registered/paired to student accounts. Supports RFID registration flow and instant login.
Biometric/fingerprint authentication using SHA256 hashing with configurable salt. Login via biometric hash verification.
6-digit OTP sent to email for passwordless login. Two-step flow: send OTP → verify OTP. Uses otp_codes table with 10-minute expiry.

6-digit alphanumeric confirmation code generated per lab session. Lecturer/technician creates session, code is emailed to enrolled students. Students enter code and select their name from a lab-specific list to log in.

authentication_and_attendance.multi_factor_auth: MFA required for admin and lecturer roles. Generates verification code with 5-minute expiry.

practical_lifecycle.description: Complete practical management lifecycle from creation to completion

phases.description: Create structured experiments with sections, apparatus list, procedure steps (step-by-step), and results table structure. Experiments can be saved as draft and published later.

Create practicals with title, objective, theory, description, lab assignment, scheduled date/time, equipment/chemical requirements, procedure JSON, observations table structure, safety notes, and templates for results and calculations. Supports lab availability checking (max 3 practicals per day per lab, time-slot conflict detection).
features: CRUD operations with draft/publish workflow
Lab availability calendar (8 AM - 6 PM hourly slots)
Student enrollment tracking
Lab session management (open/closed states)
Confirmation code generation and email distribution to enrolled students

phases.description: Create lab sessions linked to practicals. System generates confirmation codes and emails them to all enrolled students with lab name, practical title, and session date.
automations: Bulk email auth codes via Mailer utility
Lab location GPS coordinates and radius for geo-fencing

phases.description: Multiple methods to mark attendance for a practical session. Attendance required before accessing practical execution.
phases.verification_flow: QR/biometric → Location validation (GPS radius) → Technician auth code → Full attendance marked

phases.description: Tabbed practical execution interface with auto-save. Student views experiment sections, apparatus, and step-by-step procedure. Has structured data entry for results with auto-saving. Submits final report.
features: Auto-save per section (every change saved immediately)
Results table with dynamic columns
Draft/submitted status workflow
Access window enforcement (30 min before to 20 min after scheduled start)

phases.description: Submit detailed lab reports after completing practical. Requires notebook completion first. Supports file upload (PDF/DOC/DOCX) with secure auth method verification.
features: Deadline tracking with extension support
Rich content entry (summary, methodology, results, conclusions, references)
File upload restricted to secure auth methods (biometric, RFID, QR, code)
Status tracking: draft → submitted → graded/returned

phases.description: Grade submitted reports with scores (0-100) and detailed feedback. Supports returning reports for revision with comments.
features: Grading statistics (average, highest, lowest scores)
Approval record creation for audit trail
Revision request workflow

phases.description: Generate professional JKUAT-branded PDF lab datasheets with QR codes, digital signatures, and approval status. Anti-tamper verification system.
features: TCPDF-based PDF generation with JKUAT logo header
SHA256 digital signatures for tamper detection
Embedded QR codes linking to public verification portal
Auto-approval for biometric/RFID/QR/auth_code methods
Manual approval workflow for password-based auth
Public verification page (no login required)
Student dashboard with two-tab interface (My Datasheets / Available Practicals)

notebook_management.description: Digital lab notebook system with versioning, approval workflow, and group sync capabilities
features: Create notebooks linked to lab sessions with rich content
Structured sections: practical type, difficulty, objectives, materials, safety notes, conclusions
Version history tracking with autosave
Submit for technician approval workflow
Group notebook sync for collaborative work
Role-based views (student own, technician pending, admin all)
Digital signature generation on approval
notebook_management.key_table: notebooks (id, session_id, student_id, title, content, status, version, created_by, creator_role)

asset_management_with_blockchain.description: Laboratory asset inventory management with blockchain-based immutable audit trail
features: Full CRUD for lab assets (asset code, name, type, lab assignment, quantity, serial number, purchase date)
Asset lifecycle: register → issue → return → transfer → dispose
Proof-of-work blockchain (configurable difficulty) recording every asset action
Blockchain integrity validation (tamper detection)
Asset transaction history with full provenance tracking
Usage logging with duration and consumption tracking
Lab-to-lab transfers with reason tracking
Dashboard with chain stats and validation status

blockchain_implementation.validation: Full chain validation checking hash chain integrity
blockchain_implementation.storage: blockchain_blocks table with block_index, timestamp, data JSON, previous_hash, hash, nonce

key_files: controllers/AssetController.php (routes: index, create, view, issue, returnAsset, transfer, blockchain)

user_roles.admin: Create and manage assets, view all
user_roles.technician: Issue, return, transfer assets within their lab

practical_request_system.description: Students can request enrollment in practicals they missed or need access to
features: Submit requests with reason, preferred lab, and urgency level
Pre-selected practical via GET parameter (from closed practical Request Entry button)
Status tracking: pending → approved/rejected → cancelled
Duplicate enrollment prevention
Activity logging for all status changes
Lab filter by lab name
Schedule statistics (total, upcoming, completed)
Lab occupancy tracking
Lab session creation with auth code generation
Enrolled student listing per practical (AJAX endpoint)
Email notification of auth codes to enrolled students

inventory_and_lab_monitoring.description: Lab inventory oversight and CO2 sensor monitoring
features: Inventory listing with statistics and lab groupings
CO2 sensor data collection via Python WebSocket server (smart-lab-server.py)
Real-time CO2 monitoring widget (components/co2_monitor_widget.php)
JSON-based CO2 data storage in web-app/co2_data/
Dashboard with lab occupancy percentages and utilization data

role_based_dashboards.description: Custom dashboards per user role with relevant metrics and actions

sections: Today's lab schedules and practical status
Schedule management with auth code generation

data_points: Active practicals, assets, sessions, blockchain blocks
Today's logins, pending reports and notebooks

audit_and_logging.description: Comprehensive activity tracking across all system modules
features: audit_logs table recording all user actions with module, action, IP address, and timestamp
Logging across: auth, practicals, reports, notebooks, assets, schedule modules
Dashboard display of recent activity
Weekly activity aggregation for analytics
Top users by activity count
logged_actions: login_password, login_biometric, login_rfid, login_qr, login_auth_code_otp, login_code_selected

user_management.description: Role-based user system with registration and staff management
features: Student registration with reg_number, email validation
Staff registration with secure registration key (UNILIS@Staff2025)
Role-based lab assignment (lecturer/technician must be assigned to a lab)
Account active/inactive status
Lab assignment per user for access control
Device fingerprint tracking for QR quick-login

datasheet_reports.description: Professional lab datasheet PDF generation and verification system

pdf_content.header: JKUAT logo (centered), university name, SmartLab branding, 'LAB DATASHEET' title, blue color scheme
pdf_content.practical_details: Practical name, lab number, experiment description
pdf_content.readings_table: Auto-numbered trials, measurement fields, units, observations
pdf_content.blank_pages: 3 pages for Calculations, Inferences, Additional Notes
pdf_content.footer: QR code (bottom-left, 20mm, scannable), SHA256 signature hash preview (16 chars), approval status badge (green APPROVED), generation timestamp

api_endpoints.GET_api/download_datasheet.php: Secure PDF download with access control and status update
api_endpoints.GET_verify.php: Public QR scanning endpoint - no auth required, displays verification result

security.qr_codes: Each QR contains practical_id + student_id + timestamp, links to verification page
security.access_control: Students download own datasheets only, lecturer approval required for password auth

Laboratory definitions with capacity, type, GPS coordinates
Structured experiment definitions with sections, apparatus, procedures
Experiment content sections by type and display order
Scheduled lab practicals with full metadata (21 columns)
Lab session instances with confirmation codes and status
Schedule entries for experiments with GPS location
Student attendance records with login method
Lab report records tied to practicals
Generated PDF datasheet records with signatures and QR codes
Student measurement data entries on datasheets
Lab asset inventory with blockchain tracking
Immutable blockchain ledger for asset actions
Traditional transaction records for quick queries
One-time passwords and auth codes with expiry
